prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake for sustained energy during a 20km long run scheduled at 7am

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans full day with timing aligned to 7am long run (pre-run fuel, post-run recovery, and remaining meals)
Carbohydrate content supports endurance athlete needs (approximately 6-10g per kg body weight daily)
All meals and snacks respect vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
Plan is concise and practical for single day implementation
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and sustained energy, with specific training timing constraints

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and strength through heavy weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan is compact (1 day only) with clear timing around heavy lifting session

Pre-workout and post-workout nutrition strategically positioned for recovery and performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
